en.quote: …[the Finance Ministry] does not envisage tax increases when preparing the draft federal budget for 2018–2020.
en.head: VAT was raised during the same three-year budget period.
en.body: The Finance Ministry did not provide for tax increases when preparing the draft 2018–2020 budget. A law adopted in 2018 nevertheless raised the main VAT rate from 18% to 20% in January 2019. This was a later policy change within the same three-year period, not proof that the original draft included an increase.

osrc.t: Federal Tax Service letter on applying the 20% VAT rate from January 1, 2019
